scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const cp=require('child_process'); const scan=(dir)=>fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(entry=>entry.isDirectory()?scan(path.join(dir,entry.name)):entry.name.endsWith('.js')?[path.join(dir,entry.name)]:[]); for (const file of scan('static/js')) cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',file],{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:frontend
